name: vemi
description: One place for everything you are building: spaces, projects, milestones and tasks, on your own free Cloudflare account.
author: Anvil Dynamics

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/front/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run verify && node scripts/proven-on-staging.mjs && node scripts/andy-config.mjs production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.andy.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.andy.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run verify && node scripts/andy-config.mjs staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.andy.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.andy.jsonc
scripts.deploy:front: pnpm run verify && pnpm run build:front && node scripts/andy-config.mjs front && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.andy.jsonc
